nodes.name: Trigger: New File in Drive Folder
nodes.notes: Polls the watched Drive folder every hour at :10. Fires once per new file. If you switch to Dropbox, swap this node only — everything downstream stays the same.

nodes.name: Filter: Skip Already-Processed Files
nodes.notes: Remembers file IDs seen in previous executions (stored in workflow static data). Prevents the same document being processed twice if the trigger fires more than once for the same file.

nodes.name: Drive: Download File
nodes.notes: Downloads the binary content of the new file so it can be inspected and parsed.

nodes.name: Filter: Only PDF Files
nodes.notes: Only PDFs continue down the pipeline. Non-PDF files (e.g. .docx, images) are silently dropped on the false branch — add a branch here later if you want to support other formats.

nodes.name: Extract Text from PDF
nodes.notes: Converts the PDF binary into plain text. Scanned/image-only PDFs with no text layer will come out empty — OCR is not handled here.

nodes.name: Config: Workflow Settings
nodes.notes: Single place to tune the workflow: AI model, reminder lead time (only 1-day reminder for now), confidence threshold for auto-accepting a computed date, and your Telegram chat_id. Downstream nodes read from here via $('Config: Workflow Settings').

nodes.name: AI: Extract Dates via Groq
nodes.notes: Calls Groq to extract doc_type, parties, summary and critical_dates. Retries once automatically on transient failures (timeouts, rate limits). If it still fails, the error output branch sends you a Telegram alert instead of silently stopping.

nodes.name: Parse & Validate AI Response
nodes.notes: Parses the AI's JSON reply and guards against malformed output (e.g. AI wraps JSON in markdown, or returns broken JSON). If parsing fails, throws — caught by the error output branch below, which alerts you on Telegram instead of the workflow dying silently.

nodes.name: Filter: Has Critical Dates
nodes.notes: Guards against empty critical_dates arrays. Without this, an empty array would still flow through Split Out as a single 'ghost' item with all fields undefined, writing a junk row to the sheet. Documents with no dates simply skip the sheet/calendar branch entirely.

nodes.name: Split: One Item per Critical Date
nodes.notes: Turns the critical_dates array into individual items — one per date — so each can get its own spreadsheet row and calendar event.

nodes.name: Generate Unique Row ID
nodes.notes: Builds a stable id (fileId_index) used as the matching key for appendOrUpdate in Google Sheets, so re-runs update existing rows instead of duplicating them.

nodes.name: Sheet: Save Critical Date Row
nodes.notes: One row per critical date, keyed by id. appendOrUpdate means re-processing the same file updates existing rows instead of duplicating them. reminder_7_sent removed — only a 1-day-before reminder is planned for the reminder workflow.

nodes.name: Filter: Confident Enough for Calendar
nodes.notes: Only dates with a real computed_date AND confidence above the threshold get a calendar event. Low-confidence / uncomputable dates stay in the sheet flagged needs_human_review, but don't clutter the calendar with guesses.

nodes.name: Calendar: Create Reminder Event
nodes.notes: Creates an all-day calendar event for the computed date, so it's visible outside of this workflow too.

nodes.name: Sheet: Link Calendar Event ID
nodes.notes: Writes the newly created calendar event's ID back into the matching row, so the future reminder workflow can look up / update the same event if needed.

nodes.name: Build Telegram Summary Message
nodes.notes: Formats the document summary + all critical dates (found or not, reviewed or not) into a single Telegram message. Runs regardless of whether critical dates were found, so nothing gets silently lost.

nodes.name: Telegram: Send Document Summary
nodes.notes: Sends the per-document summary to your personal Telegram chat.

nodes.name: Build Error Alert Message
nodes.notes: Catches failures from 'AI: Extract Dates via Groq' (e.g. Groq API down/timeout after retries) and 'Parse & Validate AI Response' (e.g. malformed JSON from the AI). Formats a short alert instead of letting the execution fail silently.

nodes.name: Telegram: Send Error Alert
nodes.notes: Sends the error alert to the same Telegram chat, so a failed document doesn't just disappear unnoticed.

parameters.content:
# 📋 Legal Document Intelligence & Deadline Tracker

**What this workflow does:**
Watches a Google Drive folder for new legal documents (PDF). When a new file lands, it reads the text, sends it to an AI model (Groq) to extract the document type, parties, a short summary, and up to 4 kinds of critical dates (hearing / objection deadline / appeal deadline / contract renewal). Confident, computable dates get a Google Calendar event and a row in the tracking sheet. A Telegram summary is sent for every document, whether or not dates were found. If something breaks (AI call fails, AI returns bad JSON), you get a Telegram error alert instead of a silent failure.

**Sections (left → right):**
1. **Intake & Dedup** — trigger, skip already-seen files, keep only PDFs
2. **AI Extraction** — read PDF text, call Groq, validate the JSON it returns
3. **Per-Date Processing** — one sheet row + one calendar event per confident date
4. **Telegram Summary** — always fires, regardless of whether dates were found
5. **Error Handling** — catches AI/parsing failures and alerts you

**Not built yet:** a separate scheduled workflow to send the 1-day-before reminder (reads `reminder_1_sent` in the sheet).

**Config:** all tunable values (AI model, confidence threshold, your Telegram chat_id) live in the `Config: Workflow Settings` node.

### 1. Intake & Dedup
New file comes in → skip if we've already processed this file ID before → keep only PDFs, drop everything else.

### 2. AI Extraction
Extract PDF text → set config values (model, thresholds, chat_id) → call Groq → parse/validate its JSON reply.

⚠️ If the AI call fails or returns broken JSON, this branches to the error alert below instead of stopping the workflow.

### 3. Per-Date Processing
Only runs if critical_dates is non-empty. One item per date → save to sheet (appendOrUpdate, so re-runs don't duplicate) → only dates that are both computed AND above the confidence threshold get a calendar event → event ID written back to the sheet.

Low-confidence / needs_human_review dates still land in the sheet, just without a calendar event — check them manually.

### 4. Telegram Summary
Runs for every document, no matter what — even if no critical dates were found. This is your always-on notification that a file was processed.

### 5. Error Handling
Catches failures from the two riskiest steps: the Groq API call and JSON parsing. Formats a short alert (file name, which step failed, error message) and sends it to the same Telegram chat, so a broken document never fails silently.

main.node: Split: One Item per Critical Date
